scripts.build: npm run icons && npm run build --workspace web && node scripts/stage-renderer.mjs && npm run build --workspace desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win --workspace desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux --workspace desktop
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run dist:mac --workspace desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace core && npm run typecheck --workspace desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace core && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test --workspace desktop
